messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick check  finalizing design partner plan for private VPC + KMS beta. Target 6 partners, 4-week onboarding. Need: screener, feedback cadence, and acceptance gates. Ok to lock?
Riley (Solutions): Yes. Target mix: infra-first startups, regulated teams, mid-market self-hosts. Prefer teams that did PoCs.
Jo (DevEx): I'll produce a one-pager runbook and a small checks.sh for partners.
Marc (Eng): Telemetry: propose p95 latency, kv_cache_miss_rate, and no OOMs as auto-fail signals. We can set thresholds after partner-1 baseline.
Maya (Customer Success): I'll pull 10 candidates and send outreach. Offer credits + priority support to incentivize.
Ken (Legal): NDA + DPA addendum required. Will prep template; EU data residency flag included.
Aisha (PM): Draft screener: 1) VPC or on-prem? 2) Able to run pre-release and grant debug access? 3) Use case? 4) Infra team size? 5) Reg constraints? 6) Provide test dataset? 7) Join weekly async + 60m live?
Riley (Solutions): Also capture whether they can run the private eval harness.
Jo (DevEx): Runbook sample health check: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private.redwood/api/v1/health`
Marc (Eng): Acceptance for GA: all partners pass onboarding gates; no major regressions on eval prompts; >=80% report first-week usable perf. Any major regression = pause.
Aisha (PM): Action items: Jo runbook by Tue EOD; Ken NDA/DPA by Wed; Maya outreach batch by Wed EOD; Marc baseline with partner-1 in week1; Riley finalize screener. I'll schedule kickoff.
Maya (Customer Success): Noted  will ping replies here.
Aisha (PM): Locking plan if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
